stories.headline: SAP Completes Dremio Acquisition to Anchor Its Agentic AI Data Layer
stories.key_takeaway: SAP has closed its Dremio acquisition to make Business Data Cloud an Iceberg-native lakehouse, unifying SAP and non-SAP data without movement to power agentic AI across its enterprise installed base.

pull_quote.text: Enterprise AI doesn't stall because the models aren't good enough; it stalls because the data isn't ready for AI agents. Dremio eliminates that bottleneck.

data_points.label: SAP's share of the ERP market

stories.article_excerpt: SAP has closed the book on one of the year's most closely watched enterprise data deals, completing its Dremio acquisition.

stories.headline: Qualcomm's AI200 and AI250 Take the Data-Center Fight to Nvidia, With Saudi Arabia's Humain as First Buyer
stories.key_takeaway: Qualcomm is entering the data-center AI market with its AI200 (2026) and AI250 (2027) rack-scale inference accelerators, competing on memory and efficiency rather than peak speed, with Saudi-backed HUMAIN committing 200MW in a deal worth roughly $2 billion.

pull_quote.text: By establishing advanced AI data centers powered by Qualcomm's industry-leading inference solutions, we are helping the Kingdom create a technology ecosystem that will accelerate its AI ambitions of becoming a hub of intelligent computing.

data_points.label: Estimated Qualcomm revenue from the deal

stories.article_excerpt: For nearly two decades, Qualcomm's name has lived inside the phone in your pocket. Now the chipmaker wants it stamped on AI data-center racks.

stories.headline: Auger Adds $50 Million More to Its Series B as Investors Double Down on Its AI Platform
stories.key_takeaway: Auger, ex-Amazon exec Dave Clark's Bellevue supply-chain startup, raised a $50M Series B led by Eclipse, bringing total funding to $150M, as investors back domain-specific AI that executes decisions rather than general-purpose models.

pull_quote.text: We're not really a tool. We're really the new employee.

stories.article_excerpt: While much of the software industry braced for frontier models to swallow enterprise apps, Dave Clark raised money for exactly the software those models are meant to obsolete.

stories.headline: Radical Numerics Raises $50 Million Seed to Automate AI Model Design
stories.key_takeaway: Radical Numerics raised a $50M seed led by Emergence Capital to build an automated AI model-design engine and apply it toward general biological intelligence, with a stated dual mandate of biological design and biodefense.

pull_quote.text: The same models that can help cure disease may also lower the barrier to designing harmful biology. These forces are inseparable. Biology will be the most consequential application of AI.

stories.article_excerpt: Radical Numerics, founded by veterans of Stanford and the Liquid AI founding team, has closed a $50 million seed led by Emergence Capital.

stories.headline: Katalyze AI Raises $10.5 Million to Bring Agentic AI to Biomanufacturing
stories.key_takeaway: Katalyze AI raised $10.5M led by Bonfire Ventures to build a GxP-compliant agentic operating system for pharma manufacturing, already deployed at five of the world's 20 largest drugmakers.

pull_quote.text: We built an agentic operating system where every answer is grounded in an immutable record, so teams can deploy agents that are right every time and cut lab and manufacturing cycles from quarters to weeks, without ever exposing sensitive data.

data_points.label: Largest global pharma companies using it
For analysis that would take ~1 year

stories.article_excerpt: AI has rewired drug discovery's front end. Katalyze AI is betting the next frontier is on the plant floor and in the quality lab.

stories.headline: xAI Ships Grok STT 1.0, Pushing Into the Speech-to-Text Race
stories.key_takeaway: xAI's Grok STT 1.0, live on OpenRouter as of July 23, 2026, formalizes the company's speech-to-text push with $0.10/hour batch pricing and vendor-claimed accuracy that undercuts Deepgram, ElevenLabs and AssemblyAI, though benchmarks remain independently unverified.

pull_quote.text: Today, we are excited to announce two powerful standalone audio APIs: Grok Speech to Text (STT) and Grok Text to Speech (TTS). Built on the same stack that powers Grok Voice, Tesla vehicles, and Starlink customer support.

data_points.label: Grok STT overall word error rate (vendor-published)

stories.article_excerpt: Elon Musk's xAI has planted a flag in speech-to-text, with Grok STT 1.0 surfacing as a versioned, generally available transcription model.

stories.headline: OpenScience Debuts an Apache-Licensed, Model-Agnostic AI Workbench for Scientists
stories.key_takeaway: Synthetic Sciences' OpenScience is an Apache-2.0, model-agnostic AI workbench that runs the full scientific research loop locally with your own keys, positioned as the open alternative to closed research assistants.

pull_quote.text: Give it a goal. It reads the literature, writes and runs code, runs the experiments, and writes up what it found.

stories.article_excerpt: A quieter fight is taking shape in scientific computing: whether the software scientists work inside is open or owned. OpenScience is a concrete new entry.

stories.headline: China's Z.AI Finishes a 1-Gigawatt Data Center Built Entirely on Chinese Chips
stories.key_takeaway: Z.AI, cut off from Nvidia by U.S. export controls, has completed a ~1GW AI data center running only on Chinese chips to train its GLM models, showing China can build frontier-scale AI infrastructure domestically.
stories.article_excerpt: China's Z.AI has finished a data center drawing roughly one gigawatt, notable less for its size than for what's inside: only Chinese-made chips.

stories.headline: 'Agora' Uses an Internal Auction to Route Reasoning to an LLM Agent's Most Capable Member
stories.key_takeaway: Agora treats each reasoning step as an auctionable item and makes LLM agents bid using calibrated confidence, routing critical logic to the most genuinely capable solver rather than the most overconfident one; it beat matched baselines on 4 of 5 benchmarks.

pull_quote.text: By treating reasoning steps as tradeable items, Agora enables agents to bid based on their rectified competence—ensuring that critical logic is routed to the most capable solver rather than the most overconfident one.

data_points.label: Agora on MMLU-Pro vs 68.1% best single model

stories.article_excerpt: When a team of AI models works together, the loudest voice often wins, not the smartest. A new paper borrows an idea from economics: make agents bid for work.

stories.headline: New Research Shows How an Agent's Memory Architecture Shapes the Language It Invents
stories.key_takeaway: In emergent-communication experiments, how each LLM agent stores what it learns matters more than channel capacity; a persistent private notebook produced the most reliable coordination while stateless agents collapsed as the code space grew.

pull_quote.text: We show that channel capacity alone cannot predict coordination; memory architecture determines whether agents turn interaction history into stable conventions, and both dimensions are needed to understand how signals become language.

stories.article_excerpt: When two people who share no language are told to cooperate, they improvise. A new paper asks whether LLMs do the same, and what makes a durable language emerge.

stories.headline: Training-Free KV-Cache Compression Aims to Make Long-Context LLMs Affordable
stories.key_takeaway: Training-free KV-cache compression that assigns variable eviction rates across heads and layers can cut long-context memory 8x to 64x while retaining ~85-90% of full-cache quality, lowering per-query costs without retraining.

pull_quote.text: efficiently supporting long-context inference remains challenging as the memory allocated for KV cache scales with context length

data_points.label: Cache retained by DynamicKV at ~85% quality

stories.article_excerpt: Long-context models are seductive: paste in a whole codebase and reason over it at once. The problem is a hidden memory tax that scales with every token.

stories.headline: Apple and OpenAI Head Into a Trade-Secret Fight as Early Filings Land
stories.key_takeaway: On July 10, 2026 Apple sued OpenAI, two former employees and Jony Ive's io Products in N.D. Cal. under the Defend Trade Secrets Act, alleging talent-poaching and IP theft to build OpenAI's consumer hardware; the allegations are unproven.

pull_quote.text: We have no interest in other companies' trade secrets. We remain focused on building innovative technology that empowers people everywhere.

stories.article_excerpt: Apple has taken a former engineering hire, and OpenAI, to federal court, opening what may be the highest-profile trade-secret battle of the AI hardware era.

stories.headline: A Lawsuit Alleging Meta's AI Discriminated Against Workers Moves Into Discovery
stories.key_takeaway: 26 anonymous Meta employees allege the company's internal AI scoring penalized workers on protected leave during 2026 layoffs; a judge declined to block the cuts but flagged 'serious questions.' The claims are unproven and Meta denies them.

pull_quote.text: These claims lack merit and are not based on facts. Workforce management and organizational decisions were and are made by people, not AI.

stories.article_excerpt: A group of 26 Meta employees who say the company's AI steered them toward the chopping block are pushing their case into its next, more revealing phase.

stories.headline: The EU's 'Digital Omnibus' Keeps the August 2 AI Deadline but Delays the Hard Parts to 2027 and 2028
stories.key_takeaway: The EU's Digital Omnibus keeps Aug 2, 2026 for transparency duties and GPAI enforcement, but defers core high-risk obligations to Dec 2027 and Aug 2028, citing unfinished standards and unready national authorities.

pull_quote.text: We need to make doing business in Europe easier without compromising our high standards of online fairness and safety.
pull_quote.role: European Commission EVP for Tech Sovereignty

data_points.label: New deadline for stand-alone high-risk systems
Groups urging the Commission to halt it

stories.article_excerpt: For two years, 'August 2, 2026' dominated every European AI compliance roadmap. As of this week, the date survives but the feared parts are pushed years out.

stories.headline: Israel's AI Czar Courts Chipmakers and Data Centers to Defend Its Tech Edge
stories.key_takeaway: Israel's new National AI Directorate is courting TSMC, Samsung and Intel to build a 2nm chip fab and plans a 100,000-GPU data-center cluster within five years to preserve its regional tech edge against fast-spending Gulf rivals.

data_points.label: Chip node sought for a domestic fab

stories.article_excerpt: Israel's National AI Directorate says it is in active talks with TSMC, Samsung and Intel to build a 2nm fab, alongside a cluster for 100,000 GPUs.
